signals_info.description: Whether a valid traffic light is detected and associated with the current path.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time between 0.2 and 1 second from now, a valid associated traffic light shall be detected.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 0.2 秒到第 1 秒之间，应至少有一个时刻检测到有效的关联交通灯。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The system shall have a valid traffic-light association at least once during the window from 0.2 to 1 second.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 系统应在第 0.2 秒至第 1 秒的窗口内至少有一个时刻具备有效的交通灯关联结果。
